recipecard.title: Creamy Garlic Pasta
steps: Cook spaghetti in salted water until al dente. Reserve 100ml pasta water.
Gently fry garlic in olive oil until golden, about 2 min. Lower heat.
Add cream and half the parmesan. Simmer 3 min until slightly thickened.
Toss pasta in the sauce with pasta water until glossy. Finish with parsley.
tips: Off the heat for the final toss, keeps the sauce silky, not grainy.

howtosteps.title: Fix a running toilet yourself
howtosteps.warning: Turn off the water at the shutoff valve behind the toilet before you start.

steps.action: Take off the tank lid and watch a flush
steps.detail: See whether the flapper fails to seal or the water keeps rising past the overflow tube.
steps.check: you can tell which part is leaking

steps.action: If the flapper looks warped, swap it
steps.detail: Unhook the old flapper from the flush valve and clip the new one on in its place.
steps.tip: Bring the old flapper to the store to match the size.
steps.check: the new flapper drops flat and seals the opening

steps.action: Adjust the float so the water stops below the overflow tube
steps.detail: Turn the adjustment screw or pinch-clip down about half an inch.
steps.caution: Set it too low and the flush goes weak — aim for ~1 inch below the tube top.
steps.check: the tank fills, then the valve shuts off on its own

steps.action: Turn the water back on and test two flushes
steps.check: the tank refills and goes silent within a minute

howtosteps.footer: If it still runs after a new flapper, the flush valve seat may be worn — that one is worth a call to the landlord.

userpersona.title: Who the migration journey is for
userpersona.name: Priya Nandakumar
userpersona.quote: I don't want to learn your whole platform, I just want my search calls to work.
goals: Ship the v3 migration without a multi-week detour reading docs
Verify parity against v2 before flipping the flag in prod
Keep the integration boring, no surprise breaking changes later
frustrations: The migration guide assumes she already knows our internal terms
No single command tells her how far the codemod actually got
Shadow-mode parity results are buried in a log, not surfaced inline
behaviors: Skims docs for code samples first
Copies from the changelog, not the guide
userpersona.footer: Priya is why the codemod and an inline parity score outrank more docs.

statblock.title: Homebrew bestiary — session prep
statblock.name: Ember Drake Hatchling

traits.name: Kindled Scales
traits.text: A creature that touches the drake or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet takes 2 (1d4) fire damage.

traits.name: Updraft Glide
traits.text: The drake doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: Melee weapon attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8+3) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) fire damage.

actions.name: Cinder Breath (Recharge 5–6)
actions.text: The drake exhales a 15-foot cone of embers. Each creature in the cone must make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw, taking 14 (4d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much on a success.

reactions.name: Wing Buffet
reactions.text: When a creature the drake can see ends its turn within 5 feet, the drake beats its wings to push that creature 5 feet away.

statblock.footer: Balanced for a level-3 party of four — treat the breath recharge as the spotlight beat of the encounter.
